professionalSummary.tagline: Built PMX, InsurAdmin and GRCTechMe. Saved the SecureBancard launch. Led the Clutch Prep B2B product through its acquisition by Pearson. Insurance, payments, education and AI products, from Elixir backends to React apps.
professionalSummary.bio:
Hey! I'm Alexander. I write software, play drums and teach Muay Thai, usually all in the same week.

Home is Lima, Peru, where I live with my three dogs, two German Shepherds and a husky.

I studied systems engineering at UNEFA and started out in Falcón, Venezuela, as a junior programmer and an instructor teaching HTML, PHP, MySQL, JavaScript and CSS courses. Teaching never left: at SmoothTerminal and DailyDrip I built the platform and taught on it, from pixel art made with CSS shadows to WCAG AAA audits.

Right now I'm a senior staff engineer at Daring Bit Assembly, working remote on US Eastern and Italian hours. On the side I build Nebulith, my own game engine and map editor, and Sillabo, an AI course that teaches Italian to Spanish speakers.

I've played drums since 2011. Today I play in Eon and Zero Nexus, and before that in Behated Reign and En Carne Muerta, plus party bands like Retrogroove and Arpegio at bars and private events.

I've trained martial arts since I was 19. I train and teach Muay Thai at Moving Zen in Lima, I'm training for the national championship, and I roll jiu-jitsu at Monkey Jiujutsu Academy.

I speak Spanish and English, and a little Italian.

Co-architected Pearson Channels nearly from the ground up and engineered the critical, highly complex data migration pipeline from relational databases to Pearson's NoSQL infrastructure with zero downtime.
FinTech & High-Stakes Recovery: Saved a critical launch at SecureBancard by single-handedly executing 80% of the architecture for Dual BIN support, preventing project failure.
Fully engineered PMX Affiliate Marketplace and seamlessly integrated it into the Shopify ecosystem.

AI Architecture & Compliance: Successfully navigated compliance to launch GRCTechMe on the Google Cloud Marketplace. Expert in secure LLM orchestration (Gemini, Claude), secure enterprise AI portals, and custom audio TTS synthesis pipelines (e.g., edge-tts).

InsureTech & Automation Architect: Engineered InsurAdmin from scratch, a robust platform managing complex carrier feeds and agency teams. Developed the core infrastructure for Agency Rocket, including proprietary automation parsers and complex Stripe billing frameworks.
Nebulith: Creator and lead architect of a proprietary, highly optimized custom game engine, launching to the commercial market soon.
Deep Learning: Actively engineering custom neural network architectures from scratch to bridge the gap between traditional backend systems and custom AI agents.
Scalable Social Infrastructure: Acted as a core backend developer in the foundational stages of Truth Social, optimizing the Ruby on Rails infrastructure alongside Mastodon core developers.
